notes: Primary source: Cpt Hedgehog Battle HQ (data embedded in the calculator page JS, UR/legendary tier). level[res][n] = cost of the step INTO level n (Cpt array entry n-1, steps 1-40); heaven-guardian labels the same values as levels 2-40, i.e. shifted by one. Level gold total 28.95M matches lastwargame. Level ore: Cpt gives 2250/3750/5250/6750/8250 for five of the ten 4-level bands; heaven-guardian, lastwargame (194,000 total) and lastwarhandbook give 2200/3700/5200/6700/8200, i.e. 50 lower (<=2.3%); Cpt exact values used. stars[res][n] = cost of promotion to n stars, summed from Cpt sub-tiers (n-1 star tiers 1-4 plus n star tier 0). Blueprints mapped by promotion number as Cpt orders them: 1-4 stars = 5/10/15/20 legendary blueprints, 5th promotion = 10 mythic blueprints. Star 1-4 agree with heaven-guardian and lastwartutorial; star 5 gold 206M agrees with lastwartutorial and lastwargame (heaven-guardian says 200M, treated as outlier).
stepSplitNotes: stars[res][n] is the total for one star: the 4 sub-upgrades of tier n-1 plus the promotion into n. stepSplit gives each step's share. In-game 2026-10-06: a 0★ Railgun sub-upgrade cost 23.4M gold / 12.5K ore / 150 ceramic (= stars[1] 93.6M/4, 62.5K/5, 750/5) and the 2★→3★ Armor promotion cost 20.0K ore / 240 ceramic / 15 blueprints and no gold (= stars[3] 100K/5, 1200/5, 15). Verified on those two tiers only; the other tiers are assumed to split the same way.
